definitions.explanation: Two months from the current month.

examples.japanese: {再来月|さらいげつ}に{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}します。
examples.english: I'm moving the month after next.

examples.japanese: {結婚式|けっこんしき}は{再来月|さらいげつ}です。
examples.english: The wedding is the month after next.

examples.japanese: {再来月|さらいげつ}から{新|あたら}しい{仕事|しごと}を{始|はじ}める。
examples.english: I'll start a new job from the month after next.

examples.japanese: {再来月|さらいげつ}は{何|なに}も{予定|よてい}がない。
examples.english: I have no plans for the month after next.

examples.japanese: {再来月|さらいげつ}に{旅行|りょこう}に{行|い}きたい。
examples.english: I want to go on a trip the month after next.

notes: Time reference sequence: {先月|せんげつ} (last month) → {今月|こんげつ} (this month) → {来月|らいげつ} (next month) → {再来月|さらいげつ} (month after next).
